summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration_290 typography issues. Checked /, /pricing, /login, /master-admin, /dashboard, /service-desk, /crm, /staff-portal (Master Admin) and /bfpo (MOD Ops) at 1920x800 and 390x844 using getComputedStyle checks and screenshots. FIXED: (1) The Navbar org title on mobile is now one line and truncated ('Pulse …'), with no spill outside the header. (3) The Service Desk 'Inventory & Distribution' item is now on one line (h=36, letter-spacing normal). (4) dashboard-tabs now fits (sw 1246 = cw 1246). Pill-tab, nav and aside buttons now use normal letter-spacing. (5) MOD Ops 'Needs attention now' rows, the Open Jobs KPI labels and the Staff Portal card children now use normal letter-spacing, while Sign In keeps 0.1em (1.4px at 14px). Regression: every page renders in Proxima Nova and no page scrolls sideways at either viewport. NOT FIXED: (2) The /master-admin H1 on mobile still uses 0.1em (2px at 20px) and is still cut to 'Dashboard O…'. An unlayered '.theme-gymaxis h1' rule overrides the new 0.04em mobile rule.

ui_bugs.component: Mobile heading tracking (/master-admin H1 and every h1-h4 inside .theme-gymaxis)
ui_bugs.issue: The 0.04em mobile rule in index.css ~line 436 sits inside @layer base. The unlayered rule at index.css ~lines 1615-1621 ('.theme-gymaxis h1,h2,h3,h4 { letter-spacing: 0.1em }') always beats layered rules, and it also beats the H1's own 'tracking-tight' class. Measured at 390: H1 'Dashboard Overview' fs=20px ls=2px (0.1em), scrollWidth 226 > clientWidth 160, so it is still cut to 'Dashboard O…'. /dashboard H1 'Global Dashboard' at 390 is also 3px (0.1em). Fix: move the .theme-gymaxis heading rule into @layer base, or add a matching '@media (max-width:639px){ .theme-gymaxis h1,... { letter-spacing:0.04em } }' after it. Also, the heading tracking should not override explicit tracking-* utilities.

Its buttons now use normal letter-spacing, but the 11 tabs still overflow (sw 1351 > cw 1214, improved from 1490). 'Help & Tutorials' sits behind the scroll arrow. The arrow affordance exists, so this is acceptable, and it is no longer caused by the tracking.
Still 8px too wide (sw 1222 vs cw 1214, overflow:visible). Its buttons use normal letter-spacing, so this is not caused by the tracking. Likely a padding or gap issue.

Still 8px too wide at 1920 on /dashboard (609 vs 601). Its items are <Link> elements with Tailwind 'tracking-wider uppercase', so the button reset rule does not apply. They scroll with a fade mask, so this is minor.

issues: The section tab buttons ('Dashboard', 'Pending review') and the portal pills ('Platform', 'Operations Portal') still use 0.1em tracking. They are plain <button>s with no role=tab and no nav/aside ancestor, so the reset selector does not match them. Add role='tab' or a shared class so the reset applies.

The header 'SIGN IN' / 'LOG IN' buttons use 0.35px and 0.7px tracking (Tailwind tracking-* classes) instead of the 0.1em style-guide value. The /login and /pricing Sign In buttons are correct (1.4px).
Sonner toast <li> elements render in 'ui-sans-serif, system-ui' rather than Proxima Nova (seen on /crm). Set the font via the Toaster toastOptions/className or a [data-sonner-toast] CSS rule.

action_items: Fix the mobile heading tracking override: the unlayered '.theme-gymaxis h1-h4 { letter-spacing:0.1em }' rule (index.css ~1615) beats the @layer base 0.04em mobile rule and tracking-tight, so the /master-admin H1 is still cut off at 390.
Optional: apply the tracking reset to the Master Admin section tabs and portal pills (plain buttons), and set Proxima Nova on sonner toasts.
Optional LOW: the crm-tabs-desktop and module switcher are 8px too wide at 1920 (not tracking-related).
critical_code_review_comments: index.css: the brand typography is split between the @layer base rules (~418-437) and the unlayered .theme-gymaxis rules (~1608-1625). Unlayered CSS always wins, so any responsive or reset tweak made in the base layer has no effect inside .theme-gymaxis. Consolidate the two into one place.

The button reset selector ':where(p, div, h*, small)' does not include span. That is fine here because the row spans already use normal tracking, but span-only button content will still inherit 0.1em.

success_rate.frontend: 4 of 5 retest items fixed; regression checks (font and no horizontal overflow) 100%

rca of the issue: Mobile H1 still tracked: CSS cascade layers. The index.css @media rule is inside @layer base, while '.theme-gymaxis h1{letter-spacing:0.1em}' (line ~1620) is unlayered, so it wins regardless of specificity or source order and also overrides Tailwind's tracking-tight on the H1.
